prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop landing-page direction comp, 16:9 landscape
Primary request: Render the category-standard institutional landing page for Clinimed Odontologia at an exceptional craft level, first viewport plus start of the next section, edge to edge, crisp readable Portuguese, no browser frame. The visitor immediately understands the clinic, its breadth, location, and how to schedule by WhatsApp.
Input images: Image 1 is the official Clinimed logo and must stay recognizable. Image 2 is authorized real clinic photography; use its environment while removing or hiding any old PLUG name and blue/yellow visual identity.
Composition: a refined floating transparent glass-bubble menu across the top with “Início · Quem Somos · Tratamentos · Profissionais · Depoimentos · Blog · Contatos” and a green “Agende sua avaliação” action. A familiar but impeccably balanced hero combines a large real-clinic image with a clear content field. Below the main action, show three concise proof points and the visible beginning of a treatment overview.
Content: “Odontologia completa para cuidar de cada fase do seu sorriso.” “Mais de 40 procedimentos em uma clínica moderna, acolhedora e multidisciplinar.” Primary action “Agendar pelo WhatsApp”; secondary action “Conhecer tratamentos”. Proof: “Desde 2010”, “Equipe qualificada”, “Votuporanga/SP”. Next heading: “Tratamentos pensados para você”.
Visual law: bright white and softly tinted green surfaces, deep Clinimed green type, lime used sparingly for active states, authentic clinic photography, precise spacious sans-serif typography, subtle glass only in the navigation.
Constraints: category-standard by design, accessible contrast, no exaggerated claims, no fake awards, no prices, no repeated icon-card grid in the hero, no extra logos, no watermark.
